nodes.name: Send Webhook
nodes.notes: Envía UN mensaje de la cola de salida (qualifier_outbox). Lo llaman Inbound, Booking y la cola. Protegido por x-qualifier-token + guarda.

parameters.query:
SELECT o.id AS outbox_id, o.contact_id, o.kind, o.body, o.status AS outbox_status,
       s.status AS state_status, s.name, s.phone, s.email, s.timezone,
       EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM suppression_list x WHERE x.key = lower(s.email) OR x.key = norm_phone(s.phone, '57')) AS suppressed
FROM qualifier_outbox o JOIN conversation_state s ON s.contact_id = o.contact_id
WHERE o.id = $1

nodes.name: Guard Result
nodes.notes: DETERMINÍSTICO: mensaje pendiente, lead sin baja (se consulta la lista otra vez) y conversación en un estado que admite ese tipo de mensaje.

parameters.query: UPDATE qualifier_outbox SET status = 'blocked', reason = $2 WHERE id = $1 AND status = 'pending'

nodes.name: Check Window
nodes.notes: Zona del lead > prefijo del teléfono > por defecto (la fuente se registra).

parameters.query:
UPDATE qualifier_outbox SET send_after = COALESCE(NULLIF($2, '')::timestamptz, send_after),
  status = CASE WHEN NULLIF($2, '') IS NULL THEN 'blocked' ELSE status END,
  reason = CASE WHEN NULLIF($2, '') IS NULL THEN 'no_send_window' ELSE 'outside_sending_hours' END, tz = $3, tz_source = $4
WHERE id = $1 AND status = 'pending' RETURNING id

nodes.name: Defer Message
nodes.notes: Fuera de horario: el mensaje sigue "pending" con send_after = apertura de la ventana. La cola de Stale & Queue lo libera.

parameters.query:
WITH k AS (SELECT 'qualifier-send:' || $1 AS key),
ins AS (
  INSERT INTO idempotency_keys (key, workflow, execution_id, status)
  SELECT key, 'qualifier-send', $2, 'processing' FROM k
  ON CONFLICT (key) DO UPDATE
    SET execution_id = EXCLUDED.execution_id, status = 'processing', claimed_at = now(), finished_at = NULL,
        attempts = idempotency_keys.attempts + 1
    WHERE idempotency_keys.status = 'failed'
       OR (idempotency_keys.status = 'processing' AND idempotency_keys.claimed_at < now() - interval '1 hour')
  RETURNING key
)
SELECT (SELECT key FROM k) AS key, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ins) AS is_new

nodes.name: Claim Idempotency
nodes.notes: Reclamo atómico (PRIMARY KEY). Se puede reprocesar si el intento anterior quedó "failed" o "processing" hace más de 1 h.

nodes.name: GHL Send Message
nodes.notes:
CONECTA AQUÍ: credencial GoHighLevel. Endpoint/cuerpo de conversations/messages SIN verificar contra la API real.
Sin retryOnFail propio: los reintentos con backoff exponencial los hace el bucle "GHL Send Message · check".

Send-time guard (opt-outs re-checked) → sending hours in the lead's local time → idempotency → send → outbox + conversation log. Outside hours the message waits for the window to open.

### Per-step log → Postgres
